root_cause.mechanism: The remote inheritance sender schedules background sends and polls completion even with FM_REMOTE_INHERIT_PUSH_JOBS=1. Sixteen sequential fake-SSH transfers incur scheduler sleeps and extra plan-reading processes on the guarded relaunch path. The watcher exits promptly after respawn; latency consumes the test deadline.
root_cause.mask: The integration also introduced top-level watcher errors that prevented this test from reaching auto-relaunch until the preceding watcher fix landed.
root_cause.isolation_limitation: The wedge-removal patch does not apply to the historical parent: its erroneous top-level blocks are absent and its function-scoped increment already matches the correction. The control therefore runs that parent unchanged. A separate sender-only counterfactual holds the transport and remaining current code constant.

before.observation: not ok - the watcher did not exit on its auto-relaunch wake within the bound: check: secondmate ios auto-relaunched after remote endpoint dead on its configured host (host=remote-mac)

unmodified_main_local_trace.interpretation: The CI failure is load-sensitive latency, not a deterministic failure to exit. This local pass does not close the main-CI finding.

sender_counterfactual.setup: Same current public executable dependencies and synthetic SSH transport, 16 items, one job, 0.2-second transport delay per item; replace only fm-remote-inherit-push.sh with historical or current version.

fix.change: Execute serial sends directly and read staged plan/relative-path records with shell builtins. Preserve prevalidation, ordered output, concurrency, and failure propagation.

after.target_assertion: ok - watch liveness: a dead remote secondmate is auto-relaunched on its own host with one wake

main_ci.acceptance: All main jobs, including portable serial 5, must pass. PR CI or local passes alone do not close this finding.
